# let: each kind of value
let id name done ratio
let nothing missing
let state tags empty
let state.type state.since.day state.missing state.type.deeper

# let: what it refuses
let id id
let state.type state_type
let a-b
let .id
let id.
let state..type
let
as scalar str text
let @scalar id

# with: the variables exist while the command runs
with id name state.type -- transcript__show_bound id name state.type
with id -- transcript__with_again
with id -- true
with id -- false
with -- transcript__show_bound id

# with: what it refuses
with id name
with id --
with id id -- true
with a-b -- true
